title: Protocol for accelerated skeletal muscle regeneration and hypertrophic muscle formation in mice
protocol: Prepare a collagen-coated 6-well plate.
Warm culture medium to 37°C.
Subject tibialis anterior, gastrocnemius, and extensor digitorum longus muscles of C57BL/6 mice to enzymatic dissociation in 0.2% collagenase solution for 45 minutes.
Gently remove non-muscle tissues from the muscle sample.
Mince the muscle under a dissection microscope.
Incubate the minced muscle in the same collagenase solution for an additional 45 minutes.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70-μm nylon filter to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Lysate red blood cells (RBC) from the cell suspension.
Wash the RBC lysed cells.
Isolate cells using a negative selection kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Culture isolated satellite cells in growth medium consisting of DMEM, 20% FBS, 10 ng/mL bFGF, and penicillin and streptomycin.
Use 10,000–15,000 cells/well for culturing satellite cells in 4 or 8 chambered slides.
Incubate tissues in collagenase medium for a maximum of 2 hours with frequent observation.
Warm culture medium and DPBS to 37°C the next day.
Remove spent medium from wells.
Wash cells once with 1 mL prewarmed DPBS.
Add 2 ml fresh and prewarmed culture medium to continue feeding (for 35 mm dish).
Add 400 μL fresh and prewarmed culture medium to continue feeding (for 4/8 well chambered slides).
Refresh the culture medium every alternate day until cells become 50%–60% confluent.
Monitor cell morphology under an inverted microscope.
Scrape off large, differentiated colonies using a P200 pipette tip by visual recognition.
Prewarm satellite cells differentiation medium and DPBS to 37°C.
Aspirate the spent medium from the satellite cells to be induced for differentiation.
Rinse the cells with 2 mL DPBS.
Add 2 mL of differentiation medium supplemented with 10 μM LPA per well for inducing hypertrophic myotubes in a 35 mm dish.
Incubate the cells in hypertrophy inducing medium for 3–4 days.
Replenish LPA containing differentiation medium daily to differentiating cells.
Wipe the hindlimbs of C57BL/6 mice with ethanol wipes.
Inject 10 μM (50 μL) cardiotoxin (CTX) diluted in PBS intramuscularly into tibialis anterior muscles.
Insert the needle approximately 2/3 mm deep and at an approximately 20° angle into the center of the TA muscle.
Inject approximately 25 μL volume of CTX at two different sites in each TA muscle.
Inject CTX in both legs.
Leave mice for 48 hours to induce muscle injury or myofiber damage and initiate the regenerative process.
Inject 20 μM LPA intramuscularly every alternate day in regenerating muscles until tissues are harvested.
Harvest tissues at different time intervals (day 7, 14, or as required) for histological analysis.
Inject 3 μg Atx directly into skeletal muscles of C57BL/6 mice using 50 mL PBS-BSA as vehicle.
Alternatively, inject a final concentration of 10 μM LPA in 50 μL PBS-BSA intramuscularly.
Repeat injections for five consecutive days or until tissues are harvested for analysis.
Harvest skeletal muscle tissues 7 and 14 days after CTX injury for histological analysis.
Store harvested tissues in formalin for up to 24–48 hours.
Store paraffin-embedded tissues for extended periods.
